Sweet Grapefruit Margarita
By: Karen Kelly
Published: Monday, May 1, 2017 - 1:14pm

Ingredients




2 limes juiced
2 pink grapefruits juiced
4 oz silver tequila
1 tbsp honey
ice

Preparation

1 Pour fine sea salt onto a flat plate. 2 Line the rim of two glasses with lime juice from one slice of lime. Dip glass rim into salt. 3 Mix all remaining ingredients, except for fruit slices, in a cocktail shaker and shake for 30 seconds. 4 Pour into two chilled glasses and garnish with fruit. 5 Bottoms up!

About

This Sweet Grapefruit Margarita is the perfect, sweet cocktail for your next party (or a stressful Tuesday).  It’s full of fresh grapefruit flavor, just a tad sweet without too much alcohol.
